evals.prompt: 分析我提供的运营后台 Figma 文件，创建项目根目录的 DESIGN.md、preview.html 和 preview-dark.html。请覆盖变量、表格、筛选器、表单、Drawer、状态和典型列表页；Figma 有完整 light mode，但没有 dark mode。不要修改 Figma，也不要实现业务页面。
evals.expected_output: Creates a mutually consistent design-system document and two standalone previews from bounded Figma evidence, while clearly labeling dark mode as a proposed mapping and leaving the source Figma and application code unchanged.
expectations: Reads the extraction, schema, and preview references before producing output.
Samples variables, canonical components, and representative pages without crawling the Figma file without bounds.
Distinguishes verified tokens, derived rules, and unresolved inconsistencies with usable Figma references.
Creates DESIGN.md, preview.html, and preview-dark.html together at the project root.
Labels dark mode as a Proposed Dark Mapping in both documentation and preview rather than claiming it exists in Figma.
Runs deterministic validation and visually inspects both themes at desktop and mobile widths.

evals.prompt: 现有项目已经有 DESIGN.md 和明暗两个 preview。请根据新版 Figma 增量更新：按钮圆角和表格密度变了，其他 token 与页面模式仍有效。保留已有的代码映射和产品特有示例，不要重写成通用组件展板。
evals.expected_output: Performs an evidence-backed incremental update that changes the affected button and table rules across all three artifacts while preserving supported guidance, code mappings, and product-specific preview specimens.
expectations: Reads all three existing artifacts before inspecting the changed Figma evidence.
Preserves still-supported tokens, prose, code mappings, and product-specific specimens.
Updates button radius and table density consistently in DESIGN.md and both previews.
Moves unresolved conflicts to Design Inconsistencies instead of silently normalizing them.
Reports the sampled evidence, incremental scope, validation performed, and remaining gaps.

evals.prompt: 我只有两张后台页面截图，拿不到结构化 Figma 数据。请从截图整理一份可供开发参考的设计规范和预览，但不要把估算的颜色、间距或组件尺寸写成 Figma verified token。
evals.expected_output: Builds a useful but explicitly lower-confidence design-system suite from screenshots, classifying visual estimates as derived or unresolved and never presenting them as verified Figma definitions.
expectations: Continues from screenshot evidence without claiming structured Figma access.
Marks estimated values as Derived Rule or Unresolved rather than Verified Token.
Keeps the evidence scope bounded to what the supplied screenshots support.
Produces internally consistent DESIGN.md and previews with visible evidence-status notes.
Records inaccessible variables, components, states, and responsive behavior as unresolved gaps.
